plan.summary: PR-1 of the cxapi send-engine split (Codex critique 2026-06-06): additive, NO-OP schema + model groundwork. Adds nullable columns to outbound_messages / bulk_send_jobs / broadcast for the upcoming cxapi route (send_route, message_kind, instance_id, template_*, provider_* fields) and tightens ext_id uniqueness to (tenant_id, ext_id). Repository reads/writes the new columns with safe defaults; runtime behavior is UNCHANGED. No client, no routing, no sender change — those land in PR-2/3/4.
plan.q_intent: Bulk WhatsApp gonderimini cxapi /chatoperation'a tasiyacagiz. Codex kritigi sonrasi 4 alt-PR'a bolundu; PR-1 = sema + no-op model temeli (nullable kolonlar, davranis degismez).
plan.interview_notes: Codex critique P0/P1 maddeleri roadmap'e islendi (tracking/feat-projeler-cxapi-roadmap.md). PR-1 SADECE additive schema: nullable kolonlar + ext_id unique (tenant_id,ext_id). Davranis no-op — mevcut bridge yolu aynen calisir. Yeni kolonlar PR-3/PR-4'te doldurulup kullanilacak. State machine yeni statusleri (leased/posting/submitted/provider_failed/ambiguous) PR-3'te eklenir; PR-1'de status semantigi degismez. Reserved nullable: template_header_media, template_language (acilir, implement edilmez).

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Tum yeni kolonlar NULLABLE/DEFAULT'lu; PR-1 davranis degistirmez (no-op groundwork).
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Codex onerisi: nullable kolonlar paketi bolunebilir kilar; schema'yi davranistan ayirmak prod risk'i dusurur.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: yeni kolonlar yaziliyor ama OKUNUP KULLANILMIYOR — PR-3/4'te aktiflesir, dead-field degil.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: ext_id composite UNIQUE (tenant_id, external_message_id) PR-1'DEN CIKARILDI -> PR-3'e ertelendi (Codex review CQ9/Q2 + Q karari 2026-06-06).
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Tenant-scoped uniqueness'i, delivery-status lookup (FindMessageByExternalIdAsync) hala tenant-blind iken eklemek cross-tenant ambiguity'yi resmilestirir (yarim izolasyon). Roadmap G12 zaten 'onay olmadan delivery-status migration yapilmaz' diyor. Unique index + tenant-scoped lookup PR-3'te G12 onayindan sonra ATOMIK gider.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: PR-1 ext_id index'ine DOKUNMAZ: mevcut idx_outbound_messages_external_id ve lookup yolu aynen kalir (saf no-op).

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: send_route + message_kind kolonlari eklenir ama PR-1'de hep default ('mainapp_bridge'/'plain_text') yazilir.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Codex: broadcast_id!=null discriminator kirilgan; immutable route kolonu dogru. PR-1 default yazar, PR-3 routing'i bu kolona baglar.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: PR-1'de routing hala eski mantikta (kolon sadece kaydediliyor).

plan_detail.migration: arch/db/migrations/055-cxapi-send-schema.sql — IF NOT EXISTS guards, idempotent, snake_case, tenant_id scoped, INV-SEED-055 fail-loud verifier (column counts 13/5/6). (A) outbound_messages ADD COLUMN: send_route VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'mainapp_bridge', message_kind VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'plain_text', instance_id INT NULL, template_ref VARCHAR(128) NULL, template_params JSONB NULL, template_language VARCHAR(8) NULL, template_header_media JSONB NULL, provider_status_code VARCHAR(8) NULL, provider_status BOOLEAN NULL, provider_request_id VARCHAR(128) NULL, provider_error_message TEXT NULL, last_attempt_at TIMESTAMPTZ NULL, attempt_count INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 + 2 CHECK (send_route/message_kind domains). (B) bulk_send_jobs: ERTELENDI -> PR-4 (Codex CQ11 + Q karari 2026-06-06): bulk_send_jobs'in canonical arch/db/*.sql'i yok (migration-only tablo); cxapi kolonlari yazicisi + canonical sync ile birlikte PR-4'te (approved-template) eklenir. (C) outbound_broadcasts ADD COLUMN: send_route VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'mainapp_bridge' + instance_id/template_kind/wa_template_id/param_mapping/template_language + send_route CHECK. (D) ext_id unique: ERTELENDI -> PR-3 (CQ9/Q2 + G12). PR-1 yalniz outbound_messages (A) + outbound_broadcasts (C); ikisi de canonical arch/db/outbound.sql'de senkron (CQ11). Verifier 13 message + 6 broadcast kolonu dogrular.
